name: HNS_INCIDENTS_SUMMARY
description: HNS INCIDENTS SUMMARY. This tables stores all incident related data.

columns.name: INCIDENT_ID
columns.description: Incidents Summary table primary key.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Location ID :  Foreign key for Location table.

columns.name: INCIDENT_NO
columns.description: User defined unique Incidents Identifier.

columns.name: EMERGENCY_FLAG
columns.description: Is Emergency Flag.This column signifies whether the incident has an emergency.

columns.name: CONFIDENTIAL_FLAG
columns.description: Is Confidential flag. This column signifies whether the incident is checked confidential.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Deleted flag.This column signifies whether the incident is checked for deletion.

columns.name: REPORTER_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: EMP/NON EMP lookup. To check whether the witness is an employee or not.

columns.name: REPTR_NONEMP_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup column for non employee type code. FND_Lookup HNS_NON_EMPLOYEE_TYPE

columns.name: EMPLOYEE_ID
columns.description: Employee ID. From HCM. This column saves the employee id if the reporter is an employee.

columns.name: REPTR_NAME
columns.description: The full name of the person reported the incident.

columns.name: REPTR_AREA_CODE
columns.description: REPTR_AREA_CODE column : Reporter phone area code.

columns.name: REPTR_COUNTRY_CODE_NUM
columns.description: REPTR_COUNTRY_CODE_NUM column: Reporter phone country code number.

columns.name: REPTR_PHONE_NO
columns.description: REPTR_PHONE_NO column : Incident Reporter phone number.

columns.name: REPTR_EMAIL
columns.description: The email id of the person who reported the incident.

columns.name: INCIDENT_DATE
columns.description: The date the incident occured. This column is an user entered column.

columns.name: INCIDENT_CREATE_DATE
columns.description: The date incident was created in the system.

columns.name: INCIDENT_REPORTED_DATE
columns.description: This is the date that the incident reporter informed a person in authority eg a supervisor

columns.name: LOCATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Incident location type (Onsite/Offsite).

columns.name: OFFSITE_LOC_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Offsite Location Type Identifier.

columns.name: REPTR_SPECIFIC_LOCATION
columns.description: Incident specific location reported by the reporter.

columns.name: REPTR_ADDR_LINE1
columns.description: REPTR_ADDR_LINE1 column : Incident  Address Line 1 reported by the reporter.

columns.name: REPTR_ADDR_LINE2
columns.description: REPTR_ADDR_LINE2 column : Incident  Address Line 2 reported by the reporter.

columns.name: REPTR_CITY
columns.description: REPTR_CITY column : Incident  location city reported by the reporter.

columns.name: REPTR_STATE
columns.description: REPTR_STATE column : Incident state reported by the reporter.

columns.name: REPTR_ZIP_CODE
columns.description: REPTR_ZIP_CODE column : Incident zipcode reported by the reporter.

columns.name: REPTR_COUNTRY
columns.description: REPTR_COUNTRY column : Incident  location country reported by the reporter.

columns.name: INCIDENT_SUMMARY
columns.description: The Summary information entered by the reporter for the incident.

columns.name: INCIDENT_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: INCIDENT_DESCRIPTION column : Description entered by the user for the incident.

columns.name: INCIDENT_IMME_ACT_DESCR
columns.description: Description of the immediate action taken if any.

columns.name: SEVERITY_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Severity level for the incident. This column is a drop down selected by the incident reporter.

columns.name: INCIDENT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: INCIDENT_OWNER_ID column : Unique identifier for ther person/employee who owns the incident.

columns.name: INCIDENT_OWNER_ASSIGN_ID
columns.description: INCIDENT_OWNER_ASSIGN_ID column : Assignment Id for ther person/employee who owns the incident.

columns.name: TARGET_COMPLETION_DATE
columns.description: Target completion date set for the incident.

columns.name: COMPLETED_FLAG
columns.description: COMPLETED flag.This signifies if the incident is completed or not.

columns.name: ACTUAL_COMPLETION_DATE
columns.description: Actual completion date for the incident.

columns.name: INCIDENT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: INCIDENT_STATUS_CODE column: Current Incident Status. Lookup to FND_LOOKUP STATUS.

columns.name: INCIDENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: INCIDENT_TYPE_CODE column : Current Incident Type. Lookup to FND_LOOKUP ORA_HNS_INCIDENT_TYPE.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INCIDENT_APPROVER_EMAIL_FLAG
columns.description: The flag  to send email notification to incident approver .

columns.name: INCIDENT_REVIEWER_EMAIL_FLAG
columns.description: The flag  to send email notification to incident reviewer .

columns.name: BIZ_CONT_PLAN_ACTIVATED_AT
columns.description: At what time the business continuity plan is activated.

columns.name: BIZ_CONT_PLAN_ACTIVATED_FLAG
columns.description: Business continuity plan activated flag. Lookup from FND_LOOKUP.YES_NO.

columns.name: BIZ_CONT_PLAN_ACT_BY_EMPID
columns.description: Employee Id of the person who activated the business continuity plan.

columns.name: EMERG_ACTION_PLAN_ACTIVATED_AT
columns.description: At what time the Emergency Action Plan is Activated.

columns.name: EMERG_ACTION_PLAN_ACT_BY_EMPID
columns.description: Employee Id of the person who activated the emergency action plan.

columns.name: EMERG_ACTION_PLAN_ACT_FLAG
columns.description: Emergency Action Plan Activated. Lookup from FND_LOOKUP.YES_NO.

columns.name: EVACUATION_FLAG
columns.description: Evacuation Flag. Lookup from FND_LOOKUP.YES_NO.

columns.name: EVACUATION_LENGTH_OF_TIME
columns.description: Length of Time(Hrs) the evacuation is happened for.

columns.name: EVACUATION_ORDERED_AT
columns.description: At what time the evacuation is ordered.

columns.name: EVACUATION_ORDERED_BY_EMP_ID
columns.description: Employee Id of the person who ordered the evacuation.

columns.name: EVACUATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Evacuation Type. Lookup from FND_LOOKUP.ORA_HNS_EVACUATION_TYPE.

columns.name: FACILITY_CLOSED_AT
columns.description: At what time the facility is closed.

columns.name: FACILITY_CLOSED_BY_EMP_ID
columns.description: Employee Id of the person who closed the facility.

columns.name: FACILITY_CLOSED_FLAG
columns.description: Facility Closed or Operations Ceased. Lookup from FND_LOOKUP.YES_NO.

columns.name: FACILITY_CLOSED_LENGTH_OF_TIME
columns.description: Length of Time(Hrs) the facility is closed.

columns.name: RADIUS
columns.description: Distance in terms of radiating circles from the facility where the fire or explosion occurred.

columns.name: RADIUS_UNIT_CD
columns.description: Unit of measure for distance. Lookup from FND_LOOKUP.ORA_HNS_RADIUS_UNIT_CD.

columns.name: LESSONS_LEARNED
columns.description: Lessons Learned.

columns.name: INCIDENT_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: INCIDENT_SOURCE_CODE column: Source for Incident creation. Lookup to FND_LOOKUP ORA_HNS_INCIDENT_SOURCE.

columns.name: NOTIFIED_PERSON_ID
columns.description: Employee ID of the person who was notified about the incident. Non-Mandatory field.

columns.name: NOTIFIED_PER_ASSIGN_ID
columns.description: Assignment ID of the person who was notified about the incident. Non-Mandatory field.

columns.name: REPORTER_ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Assignment ID of the reporter (employee) at the time when Incident happened. Non-Mandatory field.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
